frequency_question: How often does a federal agency initiate and complete a formal derecognition of a major accrediting body within a 64-day timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes any formal administrative review, notice, comment period, advisory committee hearing, and final secretarial determination regarding the recognition of a national accrediting agency.

coverage_note: Exhaustive for major modern federal accrediting body derecognition proceedings.
known_gaps: Emergency or expedited termination pathways without standard administrative notice and comment.
skeleton: Administrative procedural steps required by federal regulations (34 CFR Part 602) for review and withdrawal of recognition of an accrediting agency, multiplied by the statutory minimum periods for notice, public comment, advisory committee review, and final decision-making.
multiplier: Notice of intent (30 days) + mandatory public comment period (at least 60 days) + advisory committee meeting scheduling + final decision window.
validity_reason: Statutory and regulatory procedural requirements under the Higher Education Act and administrative procedure regulations remain stable over multi-year cycles.
